items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: "You know that's like you and Duvivier George would maybe say..."

ctx.x: Herschel had stayed in Kansas City with Bennie Moten's band. See, because Herschel and Lester were playing an overnight. They switched. One went for kicks and one went for money. You know that's like you and Duvivier George would maybe say, all right, you go over there and I'll go over here. Overnight. All right, you cool with George, right, so George go over here and get your kicks. I'm tired of making the money. They ain't playing nothing over here. I've got to get out. O.K., you go over there. They switched…
Now the trumpets you say were Joe Keyes -
